title: OneRail uses Nvidia AI for real-time last-mile delivery optimisation
slides: What if deliveries rerouted themselves mid-route?
OneRail's new Nvidia AI optimizes each stop live.
It predicts delays minutes before drivers see them.
Your packages now dodge traffic before you feel it.
Test OneRail's demo against your current dispatch.
thread_text:
1. What if your delivery rerouted itself?

Deliveries that self-optimize mid-route are no longer sci-fi. OneRail's new system uses Nvidia AI to adjust each stop in real time.

2. Predicting delays before you see them

The AI spots traffic problems minutes before drivers notice. It recalculates instantly, keeping your packages ahead of the jam.

3. Your packages dodge traffic silently

No more waiting for human dispatchers to catch up. The system acts on live data, rerouting before you even feel the delay.

4. The future of dispatch is an algorithm

Manual route planning is obsolete. OneRail's AI learns from each delivery, making every future stop smarter than the last.

5. Test it against your current dispatch

Try OneRail's demo with your own delivery data. See if it beats your times—if it does, why stick with old methods?
